# Parapeet: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-06 · code 0c12e2ed5c51 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Learn everyday French, Spanish and Italian phrases in ten moods: to your boss, a client, a sad friend, your lover. Swipe, play short lessons, keep your streak.
**Live:** https://parapeet.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/parapeet · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/parapeet/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py parapeet` refreshes this map.

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
